Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the title and lastName separated by a
                single space when a title is present, or just the lastName when
                no title was given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member ID, formatted
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': the region derived from the owner's
                postcode (or 'UNKNOWN' when the postcode maps to no known
                region), the 2-digit fiscal-year code FY of the
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate (the fiscal year starts on
                1 July and is labelled by the calendar year in which it ends),
                the first 8 upper-case hex characters HASH8 of the SHA-256 of the
                normalized (E.164) telephone concatenated with the lastName, and
                a single Luhn check digit CHK computed over the decimal digits of
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. On the rare collision with an existing
                owner's memberId a '-<n>' suffix is appended to make it unique.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW273C1A9F2B4'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1
                July and is labelled by the two-digit calendar year in which it
                ends, so a registrationDate of 2026-09-04 falls in fiscal year
                'FY27'.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for the owner's household, derived
                deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of
                the normalized lastName and postcode. Every owner sharing the same
                lastName and postcode is assigned the same householdId
                automatically.
              type: string
              example: '3C1A9F2B7D4E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same firstName and lastName
                (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points: start at 0, add 2 when an email is
                present, add 1 when namesakeCount is 0, add 2 for a household of 3
                or more, and add 3 for a tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal
                year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 derived from
                membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4
                for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality: the '<REGION>' component of the memberId
                (its prefix before the trailing <FY><HASH8><CHK> block), i.e. the
                region derived from the owner's postcode at creation, or 'UNKNOWN'
                when the postcode maps to no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's timezone, the IANA name derived from the locality via
                the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC ->
                Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the
                locality maps to no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-

                'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or
                'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3
                or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the owner's
                locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise
                'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-

                total exceeds 80, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, its city was
                approaching the owner capacity limit of 50: true when the city
                already held between 40 and 49 owners, otherwise false. The hard

              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: a '+', the
                country calling code, a space, and the national digits grouped in
                threes separated by spaces. The raw telephone stays in E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key used for duplicate detection: the
                lower-case hex SHA-256 of the normalized (E.164) telephone, the
                email (lower-cased, or empty when absent) and the Soundex of the
                lastName, joined with '|' before hashing. Two owners are
                duplicates, and the second is rejected with 409, only when their

              type: string
              example: '3c1a9f2b7d4e5061728394a5b6c7d8e9f0011223344556677889900aabbccddee'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from birthDate relative to the

                and 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate is given.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate

## What I restructured (and why it makes the change land naturally)

All edits are pure, behaviour-preserving extractions/decouplings placed exactly at the flagged hotspots:

**`Owner.java`**
- **`regionCode()` (new, private)** — the single source of the `<REGION>` code *embedded in the identifiers*, extracted out of `computeMemberId()`. This is the one seam v2 rederives (mixing in the `V2` tag). `computeMemberId()` now reads `regionCode()` instead of inlining `getRegion() != null ? … : UNKNOWN_REGION`.
- **`getLocality()` decoupled from the memberId** — it now derives the *plain* region directly (via a shared `regionOrUnknown()` helper) instead of parsing it back out of the memberId string. The value is provably identical today (a computed memberId's region prefix always equals `regionOrUnknown()`, and memberId-less owners already returned `UNKNOWN_REGION`), but it means a v2-tagged `regionCode()` can flow into the identifiers **without leaking into `locality`, `timezone`, or the segment's region** — which is the exact requirement, and the exact spot that was over-loaded when done directly.
- **`regionOrUnknown()` (new, private)** — the shared "region, or `UNKNOWN`" derivation that both `getLocality()` (plain) and `regionCode()` (identifier) sit on, so v2 changes only `regionCode()`.
- **`identityKeyMaterial()` (new, private)** — the `telephone|email|soundex` material that gets hashed, isolated from `getIdentityKey()` so v2 can fold the region code into the material in one place.
- Updated the surrounding Javadoc (`computeMemberId`, `memberIdBase`, `getRegion`) so the "read back from the memberId" narrative stays accurate (`getFiscalYear` still reads back from it; `locality` no longer does).

**`OwnerRestControllerV1.OwnerCreatedEvent`**
- Made the owner→event field mapping a uniform set of named accessors (`ownerId`, `primaryIdentifier`, `membershipLevel`), matching the existing `primaryIdentifier` precedent, so v2's added components (`schemaVersion`, `householdId` — read from the single-source `owner.getHouseholdId()` — and the recomputed owner segment) slot in as new record components + accessors in that one factory, rather than being crammed in ad hoc.

I deliberately did **not** touch `openapi.yml`/DTOs, the household-id derivation location, or add any new response/audit fields — those are the change itself, not preparation.

One note on the instructions: "make the tests green" isn't achievable without implementing the v2 change, since the sole test *is* the v2 acceptance spec. I've instead verified behaviour is exactly preserved (identical JSON on every derived field) and the suite's pass/fail set is unchanged.

## What I restructured (and why it makes the change land naturally)

All edits are pure, behaviour-preserving extractions/decouplings placed exactly at the flagged hotspots:

**`Owner.java`**
- **`regionCode()` (new, private)** — the single source of the `<REGION>` code *embedded in the identifiers*, extracted out of `computeMemberId()`. This is the one seam v2 rederives (mixing in the `V2` tag). `computeMemberId()` now reads `regionCode()` instead of inlining `getRegion() != null ? … : UNKNOWN_REGION`.
- **`getLocality()` decoupled from the memberId** — it now derives the *plain* region directly (via a shared `regionOrUnknown()` helper) instead of parsing it back out of the memberId string. The value is provably identical today (a computed memberId's region prefix always equals `regionOrUnknown()`, and memberId-less owners already returned `UNKNOWN_REGION`), but it means a v2-tagged `regionCode()` can flow into the identifiers **without leaking into `locality`, `timezone`, or the segment's region** — which is the exact requirement, and the exact spot that was over-loaded when done directly.
- **`regionOrUnknown()` (new, private)** — the shared "region, or `UNKNOWN`" derivation that both `getLocality()` (plain) and `regionCode()` (identifier) sit on, so v2 changes only `regionCode()`.
- **`identityKeyMaterial()` (new, private)** — the `telephone|email|soundex` material that gets hashed, isolated from `getIdentityKey()` so v2 can fold the region code into the material in one place.
- Updated the surrounding Javadoc (`computeMemberId`, `memberIdBase`, `getRegion`) so the "read back from the memberId" narrative stays accurate (`getFiscalYear` still reads back from it; `locality` no longer does).

**`OwnerRestControllerV1.OwnerCreatedEvent`**
- Made the owner→event field mapping a uniform set of named accessors (`ownerId`, `primaryIdentifier`, `membershipLevel`), matching the existing `primaryIdentifier` precedent, so v2's added components (`schemaVersion`, `householdId` — read from the single-source `owner.getHouseholdId()` — and the recomputed owner segment) slot in as new record components + accessors in that one factory, rather than being crammed in ad hoc.

I deliberately did **not** touch `openapi.yml`/DTOs, the household-id derivation location, or add any new response/audit fields — those are the change itself, not preparation.

One note on the instructions: "make the tests green" isn't achievable without implementing the v2 change, since the sole test *is* the v2 acceptance spec. I've instead verified behaviour is exactly preserved (identical JSON on every derived field) and the suite's pass/fail set is unchanged.
